levels.surface: أبو محمد الحسين بن أحمد المكتب

notes: «وَ ذَكَرَ أَنَّ الشَّيْخَ الْعَمْرِيَّ ... أَمْلَاهُ عَلَيْهِ» names Shaykh al-Amri as the one who dictated the supplication; he is not written as a link, which needs ruling (rules 6 and 11)
«بِهَذَا الدُّعَاءِ» names the saying (the supplication), not an isnad, so it is not a back reference
